description: Reads GeoTIFF raster files and extracts spatial metadata including CRS, bounds, resolution, and band information.

file_path.info: Select one or more GeoTIFF (.tif, .tiff) files. Multiple files can be merged or processed individually.

file_id_variable.info: Reference an file variable for file ID(s) (e.g., {geoTiffFileId}). For multiple files, use comma separation. Takes precedence over file selection if both provided.

read_mode.info: How to read the raster data: 'metadata' for spatial info only, 'array' for full pixel data, 'sample' for random point sampling.

sample_size.info: Number of random points to sample when read_mode is 'sample'. Maximum is raster width × height.

merge_files.info: Merge multiple GeoTIFF files into a single mosaic. Only applies when multiple files are selected.

spatial_data.info: Raster metadata and data as Data objects with CRS, bounds, resolution, and optional array/sample data.

errors.missing_libraries: GeoTIFF processing requires 'rasterio'. Install with: uv sync --group spatial
errors.no_valid_files: No valid GeoTIFF files could be opened
errors.no_file_source: Please provide either a file selection or an file variable for file ID
errors.variable_not_resolved: Variable '{variable}' not found in runtime or global variables. Please check: (1) Variable is defined in Global Variables settings, or (2) Variable is passed in runtime variables when executing the flow.
